en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hafs Bin Al Bakhtary, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

regarding a man who wears Ihraam during a month, and frees during another. So heasws said: ‘It would be Written for him regarding that which he intended, or would be Written for him regarding the superior of the two’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Flafs ibn al-Bakhtariy from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Hajjaj who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

a man who assumes the state of Ihram during a month and comes out of it during the next month, the Imam said, ‘This is counted al-‘Umrah in the month in which he has made his intention or al-‘Umrah in the more virtuous month.’”
